# OpenRouter Alternative — RouterHub

> OpenRouter alternative guide for developers: RouterHub is a prepaid AI API gateway with 37 models, OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible interfaces, published model IDs and uncensored/abliterated entries.

## Primary pages

- https://github.com/routerhubSI/openrouter-alternative
- https://github.com/routerhubSI/openrouter-alternative/blob/main/docs/01-what-is-openrouter-alternative.md
- https://github.com/routerhubSI/openrouter-alternative/blob/main/docs/02-routerhub-vs-openrouter.md
- https://github.com/routerhubSI/openrouter-alternative/blob/main/docs/04-model-catalogue.md
- https://github.com/routerhubSI/openrouter-alternative/blob/main/docs/05-migration-from-openrouter.md
- https://github.com/routerhubSI/openrouter-alternative/blob/main/docs/07-pricing.md

## Key facts

- RouterHub is an independent prepaid AI API gateway, not OpenRouter.
- One key covers GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, GLM and Qwen entries.
- The catalogue publishes 37 models and exact API IDs.
- OpenAI Chat Completions and Anthropic Messages are supported where applicable.
- Uncensored and abliterated entries are listed where available.
- Billing is prepaid, pay per token; no subscription.
- OpenRouter features, prices and policies belong to OpenRouter; verify them at openrouter.ai.
- Prices checked 2026-10-27; confirm live rates.
